rejected_findings.title: derive_a11y_palettes.py references 'land' with no defining hunk
rejected_findings.reason: Script loads data/palette.json (line 97) which defines land; no in-diff hunk needed.

rejected_findings.title: small_biz tone count rises 176->197 under a shrink that should cut it
rejected_findings.reason: 197 is the palcheck-measured count (ci-local log), documented in the comment; floor canary intact (197 > 120); campus fell as expected. No defect.

rejected_findings.title: New land palette token lacks the unit-level load+fallback pin
rejected_findings.reason: No such convention exists for map tokens (water/park/coast never unit-pinned); land is pinned mechanically by palcheck exact-color floor (269,403 px) + T2 goldens.

findings.title: Scale-ratio acceptance invariants (house:band 1-2x, wide band < house footprint, role ordering) have no durable test
findings.detail: Ratios live only in PR-body numbers and re-blessable pixel goldens; a future constants edit could silently break the MM-calibrated ratios with only a golden re-bless (which would look legitimate).
findings.recommended_fix: Add a render unit test asserting house:band in [1,2], wide band < house footprint, and house < sbiz < host < campus ordering from the live procs.

findings.title: Edge-water distribution (border ~45% vs interior ~30%) is measured by no committed gate
findings.detail: The acceptance metric of the map change is PR-body-only. MAP_IDENTITY_PIN pins exact cells (any generator change fails), but the border/interior split itself is not asserted.
findings.recommended_fix: Add a harness leg computing water share for border ring vs interior on seed 7 and pin the bands.

findings.title: Thumbnail gate (hard rule 3) exists only as manual PR-body numbers - no committed tool, unlike blur_gate.py
findings.detail: The 427x240 network-hero check (band >= ~5px, node >= ~4px) ran manually; nothing prevents a future scale change from regressing the thumbnail read silently.
findings.recommended_fix: Commit a thumbnail_gate.py mirroring blur_gate.py: downscale a blessed fit capture to 427x240, assert pipe band and node pixel minimums.

findings.title: Internal spec artifact pins tier widths narrow 4.7 / wide 11.4; code ships 4.5 / 10.5
findings.detail: Briefing ACs are all met (standard band 15px, wide < house); the wide-cap rationale is documented in the PR body and code comment, but the committed plan artifact contradicts the shipped constants.
findings.recommended_fix: Amend the spec artifact's task line to the shipped values with a one-line note (wide capped at 10.5 to stay under the house footprint).

findings.title: tier_pipe_width comment claims the ladder 'keeps its 1:1.57:2.43 ratio'; shipped values are 1:1.64:2.33
findings.detail: 4.5/7.4/10.5 normalizes to 1:1.64:2.33, not the claimed preserved ratio. Misleads future tuning in a comment-heavy codebase.
findings.recommended_fix: Update the comment to state the new ratio and that the cap intentionally flattened the top of the ladder.

findings.title: MAP_LAND_LEVEL constant is dead after the edge-bias rework - referenced nowhere
findings.detail: Pass 1 now uses MAP_INTERIOR_LEVEL + MAP_EDGE_BIAS * edge_bias_factor. The old threshold survives only as an unused constant 'kept as the reference base' per its comment.
findings.recommended_fix: Fold the 0.38 historical value into the comment trail and delete the constant, or wire it as the documented base if it should stay live.

findings.title: Delivered park frame share 7.55% falls just under the PR's own ~8-10% accent band
findings.detail: Measured 69,570/921,600 px on the blessed calm frame. The band is approximate and MM reads 9-11%; the miss is 0.45pp on a '~' target - cosmetic, but the PR cites the band it misses.
findings.recommended_fix: Either nudge MAP_PARK_LEVEL down a notch in a follow-up pass or restate the band to match the measured accent share.

findings.title: PR body claims paper+land 59.0%; exact-color measurement on the blessed frame gives 53.3%
findings.detail: palcheck counts: land 269,403 + canvas 221,499 of 921,600 = 53.3%. Water 26.0% and park 7.55% reproduce; paper+land does not (measurement basis undocumented - likely a tolerance-inclusive count).
findings.recommended_fix: State the measurement basis in the PR body or correct the number; the directional claim (paper-dominant) holds either way.

findings.title: A11y oracle drops every canvas pair as land replaces canvas as the map reference
findings.detail: Dropped pairs (water/park/coast vs canvas) all passed pre-change with identical colors, and both land and canvas hexes are pinned by exact-color floors + T2 - no live regression. Theoretical narrowing only.
findings.recommended_fix: Optionally add land-vs-canvas as a documented sub-threshold pair (it sits at ~14 sRGB by design - subtle warmth, not a legibility encoder).

findings.title: Deutan and protan a11y goldens are byte-identical to each other (pre-existing, faithfully re-blessed)
findings.detail: Both modes' 30s captures share one blob hash before this PR (fcb0e96) and after (57f62e7) - the quirk predates the diff and the re-bless preserved it. Suspect the a11y demo path does not actually apply the per-mode table to the golden render.
findings.recommended_fix: Out of scope here; flag to the a11y/harness owner job to verify the mode goldens diverge as intended.

findings.title: Unknown-tier pipe-width fallback silently changes 4.5 -> 6.0
findings.detail: Recentered between narrow 4.5 and standard 7.4 (old fallback sat above old narrow likewise) - consistent, but the change carries no comment in a comment-everything codebase.
findings.recommended_fix: One comment line noting the fallback recentering with the ladder retune.

findings.title: Positional Shadow_Spec literals allow silent rx/ry transposition
findings.detail: {0.60, 0.35, 36}-style literals rely on field order; a future edit swapping rx/ry compiles clean and only shows in goldens.
findings.recommended_fix: Use named fields ({rx = ..., ry = ..., ink = ...}) in shadow_for_role/shadow_for_puck.

findings.title: Clipped grid loop never terminates if v.scale == 0 (zero-sized window)
findings.detail: Pre-existing hazard class (old full-window loop hung the same way when win_h==0); the new <= bound marginally widens it to win_w==0. raylib does not deliver 0-size frames in practice.
findings.recommended_fix: Early-return from grid drawing when v.scale <= 0.

findings.title: Advisory test gate: PASS
findings.detail: P0 deterministic-sim surface fully covered by unchanged T1/replay (byte-identical, verified); view-layer change covered by 102 re-blessed T2 goldens + palcheck floors + blur gate. Ratio/distribution gates are the advisory gaps above.
